dataList.data: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming paradigm that uses objects and classes. Python supports OOP and provides features like inheritance, encapsulation, and polymorphism.
A class is a blueprint for creating objects. An object is an instance of a class.
Inheritance allows a class to inherit attributes and methods from another class.
Encapsulation hides the internal state of an object and requires all interaction to be performed through an object's methods.
Polymorphism allows objects of different classes to be treated as objects of a common superclass.
Modularity: Code is organized into classes and objects
Reusability: Classes can be reused in different contexts
Maintainability: Easier to modify and extend code
OOP is a powerful paradigm that helps in building complex, maintainable software systems. Python's support for OOP makes it suitable for large-scale applications.
